title: Refract
summary: A session-centered research workspace that keeps papers, cited passages, grounded answers, recall attempts, comparison scopes, datasets, analysis decisions, and model results connected to their provenance.
landingDeck: Refract carries one research question through close reading, evidence capture, cross-paper synthesis, source-grounded recall, dataset auditing, and baseline modeling without breaking the links between the source, decision, and result.
landingHighlights: Connects five implemented workspaces—Reader, Index, Compare, Review, and Stats—through a persisted research session and shared source identities.
Implements page-aware PDF retrieval, source-linked answers, three-dimensional recall grading, confidence capture, FSRS scheduling, and human-grading export.
Stages quantitative work through dataset profiling, leakage and redundancy audits, explicit review, three-model comparison, saved metrics, and literature-alignment notes.
problem: A research argument is assembled across PDF readers, note systems, AI chats, comparison documents, flashcards, notebooks, and spreadsheets. Each transfer can separate a claim from its page, a comparison from its source set, a review score from its rubric, or a model result from the assumptions that produced it.
approach: Refract makes the research session the durable unit of work. Papers, selected passages, questions, comparisons, cards, recall attempts, confidence ratings, datasets, audit decisions, analysis steps, and visual outputs inherit session and source identities that survive movement across five focused workspaces.
output: A React 18 and Vite interface with a FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Alembic, ChromaDB, and S3-compatible backend; source-constrained document retrieval; comparative synthesis; structured recall grading and FSRS scheduling; and a review-gated battery remaining-useful-life analysis workflow.

methodology.evaluation: Backend tests and Playwright probes cover ingestion, retrieval, page sources, session state, comparison payloads, recall-first interaction, duplicate repair, legacy context recovery, and Stats layout. Review and analysis records retain source, prompt, rubric, model, confidence, reveal, scheduler, dataset, audit, metric, and decision provenance.
methodology.boundary: The product and its study instrumentation are implemented; longitudinal retention and production predictive-maintenance outcomes are separate validation programs enabled by the stored research records.

role: I designed the research model and product workflow; built the document reader, evidence index, comparison system, recall and grading pipeline, research exports, session and migration layers, and Stats workspace; and translated the literature review into testable product instrumentation.

pageSections.title: One research session connects the paper page to the analytical decision
pageSections.description: A researcher can move from a highlighted passage to a grounded response, saved evidence, a cross-paper comparison, a recall attempt, a rubric result, a scheduled review, a dataset audit, and a model comparison without losing the identifiers and decisions that connect the sequence.
pageSections.context: Reader, Index, Compare, Review, and Stats operate as distinct tools over the same persisted research state.

pageSections.title: Refract stores the relationships that research tools usually leave implicit
pageSections.markdown:
The research problem is larger than finding a relevant paragraph. A defensible argument requires the researcher to remember which paper and page supported a note, which sources were included in a synthesis, which evidence shaped a question, what the learner knew before seeing the answer, and which assumptions produced a statistical result. Refract makes those relationships first-class records.

A session has a goal, domain, methodology, population, outcome, inclusion criteria, and status. PDFs can participate in more than one session through membership records. Saved passages retain their document and location. Comparisons retain both the selected paper set and the framing question. Review attempts retain the learner response, confidence, source-reveal behavior, rubric and prompt versions, model identity, feedback, and scheduler transition. Analysis steps retain dataset identity, predictor decisions, audit warnings, acceptance state, model settings, metrics, artifacts, and literature-alignment notes.

This structure reduces the reconstruction work that normally happens at the end of a study. A later reviewer can recover the source, version, state, and decision behind an answer or result instead of relying on a final narrative that has already compressed away the research path.

pageSections.title: Read the paper, inspect the evidence, and ask from the same surface
pageSections.description: The Reader keeps the PDF visible while the researcher selects a passage, asks a document-grounded question, generates a study prompt, saves evidence, or jumps from a cited page marker back to the source. The response returns page and chunk metadata to the interface.

pageSections.title: Five focused workspaces form one recoverable research workflow

items.label: Reader
items.title: Interrogate a paper at passage level
items.body: Open a PDF, select text, ask a grounded question, transcribe microphone input, follow page-linked sources, and save evidence without leaving the document.

items.label: Index
items.title: Recover saved evidence and questions
items.body: Browse passages, notes, cards, facets, source links, and research context retained from the active session, including older records repaired into the current schema.

items.label: Compare
items.title: Synthesize a bounded source set
items.body: Run a research question across selected papers, track progress and source coverage, retain per-paper analyses, and mark the result stale when its framing or paper set changes.

items.label: Review
items.title: Turn evidence into measurable recall
items.body: Answer before reveal, record confidence, receive source-grounded feedback across three dimensions, update FSRS state, and retain the attempt for later human grading.

items.label: Stats
items.title: Audit and model session data
items.body: Profile a dataset, identify leakage and redundancy risks, approve the feature frame, compare three baselines, and store metrics, coefficients, feature importance, and visual artifacts with the run.

pageSections.title: The retrieval path keeps every answer tied to the active paper
pageSections.description: Refract implements the complete retrieval path directly in its application services, making the chunking, filtering, relevance threshold, source metadata, and fallback behavior inspectable.

items.label: Extract
items.title: Carry page identity through ingestion
items.body: PyMuPDF extracts the document page by page. tiktoken with cl100k_base creates 512-token chunks with 50-token overlap while retaining the PDF ID, page number, and chunk index.

items.label: Retrieve
items.title: Search the active document's vector collection
items.body: L2-normalized all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings are stored in ChromaDB with cosine distance. Each question retrieves the top five chunks filtered to the active PDF.

items.label: Cite
items.title: Return source metadata to the interface
items.body: Claude receives the retrieved excerpts and produces an answer with page-linked source records; clickable page markers take the researcher back to the supporting location.

items.label: Route
items.title: Treat weak evidence as a product state
items.body: When all five distances exceed 1.3, selected-passage questions stay bound to the highlight, document questions remain on the document path, and genuinely external questions use a separately labeled web route.

pageSections.title: A review attempt measures recall before the source changes the answer
pageSections.description: The loop joins retrieval practice, confidence calibration, source-grounded grading, feedback, and scheduling while retaining enough provenance for human agreement studies and later rubric revision.

items.label: Prompt
items.title: Generate from selected academic evidence
items.body: Create or refine a recall item from a saved passage, expected answer, rhetorical facet, or research concept while retaining the source relationship.

items.label: Recall
items.title: Answer and rate confidence before reveal
items.body: Capture the learner's free-recall response and confidence while the source remains hidden, separating remembered knowledge from recognition.

items.label: Grade
items.title: Evaluate claim, detail, and faithfulness
items.body: A temperature-zero, versioned grading call returns JSON for the core claim, supporting detail, source faithfulness, rubric hits, omissions, feedback, and model confidence.

items.label: Reveal
items.title: Reconnect feedback to the original passage
items.body: Show the source according to the selected reveal mode and retain whether assistance occurred so later analysis can distinguish independent recall from aided review.

items.label: Schedule
items.title: Convert the assessment into review state
items.body: Store the original 1-5 result, map it to the 1-4 FSRS signal, update the next review date, and retain the complete attempt for export or human scoring.

pageSections.title: The research question and selected papers remain attached to the synthesis
pageSections.description: Compare runs asynchronous per-paper analysis, organizes agreements, disagreements, methodological differences, gaps, and guidance, and fingerprints the output to both the framing question and source set. A changed source or question makes the prior result visibly stale instead of silently reusing it.
pageSections.caption: Cross-paper comparison interface from the public repository.

pageSections.title: Battery analysis makes data quality and predictor decisions reviewable
pageSections.description: The Stats workspace stores the dataset schema and identity, profiles every variable, flags missingness, constants, identifier-like fields, target leakage, and correlated predictors, then pauses for human acceptance before fitting a mean baseline, standardized Linear Regression, and Random Forest.
pageSections.caption: Battery remaining-useful-life workspace with analysis outputs linked to the active research session.

pageSections.title: Each statistical checkpoint leaves an inspectable record
pageSections.description: The quantitative workflow behaves like a staged research notebook: later steps inherit accepted inputs and become stale when an earlier decision changes.

items.label: Profile
items.title: Describe the uploaded dataset
items.body: Record rows, columns, duplicates, missingness, inferred types, numeric summaries, target candidates, role hints, and variable semantics.

items.label: Audit
items.title: Surface leakage and redundancy risks
items.body: Check constants, identifiers, timing, target correlation, probable leakage at |Spearman rho| >= 0.97, and predictor redundancy at |rho| >= 0.95.

items.label: Review
items.title: Accept the feature frame explicitly
items.body: Require a human decision on exclusions, target, predictors, assumptions, and warnings before model execution can proceed.

items.label: Compare
items.title: Fit three interpretable baselines
items.body: Use an 80/20 split with random_state 42 to compare a train-mean baseline, standardized Linear Regression, and a 240-tree Random Forest using MAE, RMSE, and R-squared.

items.label: Retain
items.title: Store the result with its decisions
items.body: Keep step versions, acceptance, stale state, metrics, coefficients, feature importance, artifact manifests, literature evidence, and reviewer notes with the run.

pageSections.title: Every generated result carries the evidence and version state needed to audit it

items.label: Retrieval
items.title: Paper, page, chunk, and distance
items.body: Grounded answers and saved evidence retain the source document, page, chunk identity, retrieval distance, and active-session relationship.

items.label: Comparison
items.title: Question, source set, and freshness
items.body: Comparative outputs retain the framing question, selected papers, per-paper analysis, source coverage, progress state, and fingerprint used to detect stale results.

items.label: Recall
items.title: Answer, confidence, rubric, and scheduler
items.body: Review logs include the learner response, pre-grade confidence, dimension scores, feedback, exact model, prompt and rubric versions, reveal mode, and FSRS transition.

items.label: Statistics

pageSections.title: The literature review shaped what the product records and when it asks for judgment
pageSections.markdown:
The product was developed alongside a structured review of the testing effect, generative learning, FSRS, confidence calibration, LLM grading, scholarly-reading interfaces, and authentic classroom studies. That research changed the interaction design: learners answer before source reveal; confidence is captured before feedback; the scheduler receives a structured assessment; paper comparisons retain rhetorical and methodological facets; and research exports separate assisted from independent recall.

The grading path is reproducible. The active service pins claude-sonnet-4-20250514, uses temperature zero, rubric version v1.0 and prompt version grading_v1.0, passes source chunks and an expected answer, requests JSON-only output, and stores model confidence, rubric hits, missing concepts, and feedback. The original 1-5 result remains available alongside the 1-4 FSRS conversion, so a revised mapping can be studied without rerunning the model.

A human_grades table and blinded export support agreement studies between model and human assessors. This design treats model grading as a measurable research component with inspectable inputs and outputs, giving the system the instrumentation needed for longitudinal retention and inter-rater-reliability studies.

pageSections.title: Custom services keep the research model visible across interface, storage, retrieval, and analysis

items.label: Records
items.title: Durable relational state and migrations

pageSections.title: Refract reduces reconstruction work across learning, research review, and applied analysis

items.label: Researchers
items.title: Carry source context into every downstream task
items.body: A passage can become a grounded answer, indexed note, comparison input, recall item, and later citation while retaining the document relationship that makes it defensible.

items.label: Learners
items.title: Turn highlighting into assessed retrieval practice
items.body: The Review workspace captures an unaided answer, confidence, source-grounded feedback, and a scheduled next attempt instead of treating reading activity as evidence of learning.

items.label: Reviewers
items.title: Inspect how a synthesis or grade was produced
items.body: Source fingerprints, prompt and rubric versions, reveal behavior, human-grade export, and stale-state rules make later review possible without reconstructing the workflow from screenshots.

items.label: Applied teams
items.title: Join qualitative evidence to quantitative decisions
items.body: Dataset audits, review gates, baseline comparisons, metrics, and literature-alignment records keep the modeling result connected to both the data and the research question.

pageSections.title: I designed and built the product, research model, and evaluation instrumentation
pageSections.markdown: I created the session-centered architecture; implemented the document reader, page-aware retrieval, evidence index, cross-paper comparison workflow, active-recall and grading loop, FSRS scheduling, human-review export, database and migration model, recovery and deduplication paths, and review-gated Stats workspace; and translated the literature review into the product's confidence, reveal, provenance, and study instrumentation.

pageSections.title: A working research system with instrumentation for longitudinal studies
pageSections.markdown:
The implementation covers ingestion, retrieval, evidence capture, comparative synthesis, recall grading, scheduling, human-review export, dataset profiling, leakage and redundancy audit, model comparison, visualization, and run-level provenance.

The stored records support future measurement of long-term retention and human-grader agreement. The battery workflow is an implemented analytical environment; production predictive-maintenance deployment remains a separate operational program.
